title: 第25章 诡异势力的反应抵达元兽山脉第26章 元兽秘境
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
中州。
在某处鲜为人知的山脉深处。
这里宫殿无数，人数众多，整片山脉都散发出邪恶的气息。
似乎某个邪恶势力的所在地。
但是因为被一道隐匿的大阵笼罩，非修为高深者仔细观察，是不会发现此地异常的。
此时，一座豪华的宫殿中，一位身体枯瘦如柴，身着黑色长袍的老者，正盘坐于蒲团之上打坐。
“噗哧！”
突然间，他那紧闭的双眼猛地睁开，两道猩红的血气如闪电般激射而出，整个人气息紊乱，仿佛受到了某种重创。
随后，他吐出一口鲜血，可是骇人的是，那血竟然是黑色的。
不仅如此，那黑色的血还散发着阵阵魔气，诡异无比。
“是谁？竟敢毁我分魂！”
一道如地狱饿鬼般嘶哑的声音骤然响起，犹如惊雷在宫殿内炸响，震得宫殿摇晃不止。
老者的血色双眸之中，仿佛有两团熊熊燃烧的火焰。
他那通天境六重天的恐怖修为，如火山一般猛然爆发，一股排山倒海般的威压，自他体内喷涌而出。
如狂风般席卷而出，所过之处，宫殿剧烈摇晃，仿佛要被这股威压生生撕裂，而后向着其他地方急速蔓延开来。
宫殿外，有一些修为较低的人，因为承受不住压力而死了。
“老四你发什么疯？还不赶紧收了气势，你想毁了整个宗门吗？”
“老四冷静点！”
两道声音响起，伴随而来的是两道人影。
一人是中年模样，虽然身穿白袍，手持白扇，但是浑身上下却散发着邪气。

另一人则是一位身姿曼妙的妖艳女子，一双桃花眼妩媚动人，性感红唇微微张开，其身体曲线饱满，虽身穿长袍，却露出点点春光。
见二人到来，老者这才收了威压。
他面色阴沉如水，沉声道：“我的分魂没了，但我还不知道发生了什么。”
“什么？到底怎么回事？”
中年人一听，脸色一变，连忙开口道：“你该不会惹上圣地中的人了吧？”
“对啊，你是通天境六重天的势力，就算是分魂控制别人，那也有通天境三重天的实力。”
妖艳女子也开口道：“就算你打不过也可以逃走，怎么分魂就被毁了？”
黑袍老者咬牙切齿：“前几天，左尊者大人找到我，说是在东荒域东荒山脉疑似发现了符合目标之人。”
“于是，我便派出了我手下的血七，命令他带人前往东荒山脉将人抓回来。”
“为了确保万无一失，我将自己的一缕分魂放在他识海中，只要遇到情况，我会出手。”
说到此处，他悔恨不已，眼中尽是懊悔之意。
“可是现在，我的分魂自爆了。”
“我现在什么都不知道，也不理解为何我的分魂自爆了。”
老者一口气将他知道的情况全部说了出来。
半晌后，中年男子沉吟道：“难不成是我们的秘密被发现了？”
“不可能！
门主大人说过，至少是逍遥圣人才能知道探查到我们的不同。”
黑袍老者沉思道：“东荒有逍遥圣人的势力只有四个，三大圣地加上东荒山脉的银月天狼族。”
一般除非宗门遭遇重大危机，否则逍遥圣人是不会出世的。
因为逍遥境乃是开始接触天地大道的境界，到了此境界后，基本都在宗门禁地闭关悟道，以求证道大帝。

所以他认为应该是血七莽撞行事，惹到了某位通天境的存在，导致连带自己分魂在内全军覆没。
老者阴森道：“不过此事我要彻查，第一，为了左尊者大人的目标，第二，即便我当初在放置分魂时删除了重要记忆，但是难免会引起别人的注意。”
“只有确保没有人发现我们的秘密，我们才能一直隐藏在暗中，否则—”
content_en:
Zhongzhou.
Somewhere deep in a little-known mountain range.
There are countless palaces and people here, and the entire mountain range exudes an evil aura.
It seems to be the location of some evil force.
However, because it is shrouded by a hidden formation, those who are not advanced in cultivation will not notice anything unusual here if they observe carefully.
At this time, in a luxurious palace, an old man with a skinny body and a black robe was sitting cross-legged on a futon and meditating.
"Pfft!"
Suddenly, his closed eyes suddenly opened, and two streaks of scarlet blood shot out like lightning. His whole person's aura was chaotic, as if he had been severely injured.
Then, he spit out a mouthful of blood, but what was shocking was that the blood turned out to be black.
Not only that, the black blood also exuded bursts of demonic energy, which was extremely weird.
"Who is it? How dare you destroy my soul!"
A hoarse voice like a hungry ghost in hell suddenly sounded, like thunder exploding in the palace, shaking the palace.
There seemed to be two blazing flames in the old man's bloody eyes.
His terrifying cultivation level of the sixth level of the Heaven-reaching Realm suddenly erupted like a volcano, and an overwhelming pressure surged out of his body.
It swept out like a violent wind, and wherever it passed, the palace shook violently, as if it was about to be torn apart by this pressure, and then spread rapidly to other places.
Outside the palace, some people with lower cultivation levels died because they could not bear the pressure.
"Old Fourth, why are you so crazy? Why don't you calm down quickly? Do you want to destroy the entire sect?"
"Fourth, calm down!"
Two voices sounded, followed by two figures.
One person looked middle-aged. Although he was wearing a white robe and holding a white fan, his whole body exuded an evil aura.
The other person is a charming woman with a graceful figure, a pair of charming peach blossom eyes, sexy red lips slightly open, her body curves are full, and although she is wearing a robe, she shows a little bit of spring.
Seeing the two people arriving, the old man gave up the pressure.
His face was as gloomy as water, and he said solemnly: "My soul is gone, but I still don't know what happened."
"What? What's going on?"
When the middle-aged man heard this, his expression changed and he quickly said, "You won't offend the people in the Holy Land, right?"
"Yes, you are a force at the sixth level of Tongtian Realm. Even if you control others with your soul, you still have the strength of the third level of Tongtian Realm."
The charming woman also spoke: "Even if you can't beat me, you can still escape. How come your separate soul is destroyed?"
The black-robed old man gritted his teeth: "A few days ago, Master Zuo came to me and said that he suspected that he had found someone who met the target in the Donghuang Mountains of the Eastern Barren Territory."
"So, I sent out my subordinate Xue Qi and ordered him to take people to the Donghuang Mountains to capture them."
"To ensure nothing goes wrong, I put a fragment of my soul in his sea of consciousness. Whenever I encounter a situation, I will take action."
When he said this, he felt regretful and his eyes were filled with regret.
"But now, my soul has exploded."
"I don't know anything now, and I don't understand why my soul exploded."
The old man told everything he knew in one breath.
After a while, the middle-aged man pondered: "Is it possible that our secret has been discovered?"
"Impossible!
The master of the sect has said that at least only the Happy Sage can detect our differences. "
The black-robed old man thought deeply: "There are only four forces of Xiaoyao Saint in the Eastern Barren. They are the three holy places plus the Silver Moon Sirius Clan in the Eastern Barren Mountains."
Generally, unless the sect encounters a major crisis, the Happy Saint will not be born.
Because the Xiaoyao realm is the realm where one begins to come into contact with the great ways of heaven and earth. After reaching this realm, one basically stays in seclusion in the sect's forbidden area to realize the Tao, in order to attain enlightenment as the Great Emperor.
Therefore, he thought that Xue Qi acted recklessly and offended a certain being in the Heaven-reaching Realm, causing the entire army to be annihilated, including his own soul.The old man said grimly: "But I want to investigate this matter thoroughly. First, for the sake of Master Zuo's goal. Second, even if I deleted important memories when I placed the divided soul, it will inevitably attract the attention of others."
"Only by ensuring that no one discovers our secret can we remain hidden, otherwise-"
